title: American Revolution
summary: Thirteen colonies on the eastern seaboard broke from the British Empire and forged a republic that would reshape the modern world.

stories.title: War of Independence
stories.summary: From the first shots at Lexington to the surrender at Yorktown, the colonies fought for self-rule.

events.title: Lexington & Concord
events.body: British regulars marched to seize colonial arms at Concord. Militia at Lexington and along the road back to Boston fired the opening shots of the war.

events.title: Bunker Hill
events.body: Rebel militia fortified Breed's Hill above Boston. British assaults finally took the position, but at a cost that showed the colonies could stand against the Crown.

events.title: Saratoga
events.body: Horatio Gates trapped and defeated a British army under Burgoyne in upstate New York. The victory persuaded France to enter the war on the American side.

events.title: Valley Forge
events.body: Washington's army endured a brutal winter encampment. Drill under von Steuben and renewed supply transformed a ragged force into a professional army.

events.title: Yorktown
events.body: French and American forces besieged Cornwallis on the Virginia peninsula. His surrender effectively ended major fighting and secured independence.

stories.title: Road to Revolution
stories.summary: Taxation, protest, and the crisis of empire before the first shots.
